lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀嗡嗡响
lines.en: I hang in the air, wings buzzing

lines.zh: 飞行的时候，装得像只蜜蜂
lines.en: When flying, I pass for a bee
I loop the flowers without landing

lines.zh: 翅膀是透明的，可声音太沉
lines.en: The wings are clear, but the sound is too low
I fly a stretch along the fence
One push of wind and I drift

lines.zh: 这样飞，不碰到人是很难的
lines.en: Flying like this, avoiding people is hard

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，蜜蜂不该快
lines.en: I fly slowly, a bee should not be fast

lines.zh: 身上有黄黑条纹，画得很粗
lines.en: Yellow and black stripes, painted too boldly

lines.zh: 我在不同的花之间来回
lines.en: I shuttle between different flowers

lines.zh: 飞起来才发现，翅膀数不对
lines.en: Only in flight do the wrong number of wings show

lines.zh: 我一靠近，别的蜂就散了
lines.en: When I come near, other bees scatter
The flowers have not opened, I arrived first

lines.zh: 我悬在篱笆上头看了一圈
lines.en: I hover over the fence and take a look
The wing sound is very convincing
I circle around the beehive
I rest on a grass stalk

lines.zh: 翅膀收起来，还在轻轻颤
lines.en: My wings fold, still quivering

lines.zh: 花是开的，蜜不是我采的
lines.en: The flowers are open, the nectar is not what I take
I wait here
Six legs, I have counted them several times
The sun warms my shell
From a distance this looks very much right
The swarm will not let me near
There is pollen in the air

lines.zh: 我动了动触角，学蜂的样子
lines.en: I twitch my antennae the way a bee would

lines.zh: 风一停，我的嗡嗡声就很清楚
lines.en: When the wind stops, my buzzing is very clear
I can hold this pose a long time

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，我在你眼前
lines.en: While you look up, I am right before your eyes
My wings buzz beside your face

lines.zh: 你分不清我和蜜蜂，这很好
lines.en: You cannot tell me from a bee, which is good

lines.zh: 我看着你这张脸，觉得很合适
lines.en: I look at your face and find it suitable
Do not swat, it is very rude

lines.zh: 黄黑条纹，是给天敌看的
lines.en: The stripes are for predators to see

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就跟半步
lines.en: Take half a step back and I take half forward

lines.zh: 这副样子，连蜜都不用采
lines.en: In this shape, I need not even gather nectar

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有一块颜色，和我不一样
lines.en: There is a color on your clothes that I do not have

lines.zh: 翅膀破了一角，飞起来歪
lines.en: A corner of my wing is torn, my flight wobbles
I dropped into the flowers

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，可我还飞得动
lines.en: That was hard, but I can still fly
The buzzing broke off once
A patch of the stripes has rubbed off
I crawled two steps on the ground
One leg is bent, not obviously
This disguise is broken and hard to mend
I fly lower, to save effort
Your hand beat mine
I cannot taste nectar
Luring me with a flower is a good try

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上，装模作样
lines.en: I land on the petal and put on a show

lines.zh: 这花是摘下来的，快枯了
lines.en: The flower was picked and is wilting
I do not sip, I only look

lines.zh: 你把花举低，我就落上去
lines.en: Lower the flower and I will land
Hold still, a bee would notice
It smells sweet, and sweetness has nothing to do with me

lines.zh: 我在花瓣上停了一会儿
lines.en: I stayed on the petal a while

lines.zh: 再香的蜜，也换不来你的命
lines.en: The sweetest nectar will not buy your life
One swat and I dropped a stretch

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，又正过来
lines.en: I tumbled and righted myself
My wing struck your finger
Do not swat, I said
That left my flight crooked

lines.zh: 我贴在你肩上停了一下
lines.en: I landed on your shoulder a moment
A bee would not collide like that

lines.zh: 你身上有个地方，我记住了
lines.en: There is a spot on you I have noted
I am airborne again

lines.zh: 你再拍一次，我就不装了
lines.en: Swat again and the act ends
I cannot get into the swarm's business
These stripes are painted on
If you want a queen, do not look here
I circle you only to look
The count is right, the smell is wrong

lines.zh: 蜂会用跳舞说话，我不会
lines.en: Bees speak by dancing, I do not
That, I cannot imitate

lines.zh: 花丛里同类很多，可都不是
lines.en: Plenty of my kind in the flowers, none of them mine
I have stopped, and I do not intend to land

lines.zh: 你身上有种甜味，别靠太近
lines.en: There is a sweetness on you, stay back
I grip it with my legs and cannot fly
This is heavier than I am
I dropped and lifted again
There is something bright on the flower
I do not gather, nor do I pick up
Six legs cannot hold it
I push it off the petal
Once in the grass it is lost
Your hands are more useful than mine

lines.zh: 我悬在上头看了一会儿
lines.en: I hovered above it a while
I have caught your smell now

lines.zh: 翅膀的声音变了一个调
lines.en: The pitch of my wings has changed
A bee would not stare like this
I halt above the flowers
You are the only one in this patch
You did not check above
I dropped a little lower
This costume will not last until dark

lines.zh: 我贴在你后颈的高度飞
lines.en: I fly at the height of your nape
Swing at me and I rise
The flowers are too low to help you

lines.zh: 我在你的视野边上，总差一点
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your vision, always a little off
You spin, I orbit
I fly slower in the shade
Your sweat thickens the scent
I rested once behind your shoulder
When you stop, I land
The nectar cannot cover your smell
I strike your face, lightly
That was a sting, not a bump
I pass by your ear

lines.zh: 你伸手，我落在你手腕上
lines.en: You reach, and I settle on your wrist
Six legs dig into your skin

lines.zh: 这点力气，慢慢才显出来
lines.en: This force shows itself slowly

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，你还以为是虫
lines.en: I bit, and you thought it was a bug
You slapped your own face
I paused an instant at your nape

lines.zh: 这一下比蜂轻，也比蜂久
lines.en: Lighter than a bee, and it lasts longer
There is one more in the flowers
I fly out from the swarm

lines.zh: 翅膀一响，周围的蜂散开
lines.en: My wings start and the nearby bees scatter

lines.zh: 一朵花上没有蜜，我停在那儿
lines.en: There is no nectar on that flower, I rest there

lines.zh: 黄黑条纹在阳光下很亮
lines.en: The stripes gleam in the sun
I come from beyond the fence
A shadow has fallen on the flower

lines.zh: 空气里多了一点别的味道
lines.en: There is a new smell in the air
I fly slower than a bee, which suits me

lines.zh: 这身样子，是从别处学来的
lines.en: This look was learned elsewhere
The flame curled my wings

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，壳先着地
lines.en: I fell and landed shell first
My wings are wet, I cannot fly

lines.zh: 一支箭的风就把我掀偏了
lines.en: The wind of an arrow knocked me aside
That force numbed my wings

lines.zh: 花都枯了，我什么都没吃
lines.en: The flowers have withered, I have eaten nothing
A flash of lightning and I dropped a stretch
